segments.lyricTrigger: Refrains aligned independently, not copied.

segments.cameraIntent: Begin at human scale; reveal second light slowly.

segments.lyricTrigger: Very short embedded Farcaster cue requires acoustic re-audit.

segments.cameraIntent: Return to learned chorus composition before moving closer to threshold.

segments.lyricTrigger: Final-chorus entrance candidate.

segments.action: The place is inhabited; keep doorway state, practical light and reading stable.
segments.lyricTrigger: Specific Im-still-here and Leave-it-on intervals reviewed independently.

segments.lyricTrigger: Outro river/window reference lines.
